data.revised_prompt:
Create a single high-quality PNG sprite sheet for a 2D game attack ability FX animation titled "Imperial Card Seizure". Use the provided Caesar / Boss K avatar only as visual identity reference: deep royal blue dragon energy, sharp spiky silhouette language, white-blue flame edges, gold antler crown arcs, pearl core, dark regal final-boss mood. Use the provided 3x4 guide only for layout: 3 rows by 4 columns equal invisible frame slots, 12 frames read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Do NOT reproduce the guide: no visible boxes, no safe-area rectangles, no center marks, no labels, no borders, no guide background.

Canvas: single sprite sheet divided invisibly into 3 rows x 4 columns. Background everywhere between and around frames must be pure solid flat chroma-key magenta #FF00FF. No transparency. No visible grid lines, frame borders, labels, text, numbers, letters, UI, watermark. Each FX centered in its cell with generous magenta padding; nothing touches or crosses cell edges; consistent visual center and scale.

Subject: FX-only attack / cast ability activation overlay for Caesar / Boss K, final boss. Do not include full character body, face, hands, or attack pose. The effect should imply royal theft judgment: capturing energy from many cards, seizing one blank card from the opponent deck, converting it into a blue dragon-crown strike. Compact overlay suitable for fixed-size avatar cell.

Style: project-native clean HD pixel-inspired RPG battle sprite FX, crisp readable silhouettes, sharp clean edges, saturated aquatic fantasy palette, transparent-ready edges. Visual motifs: deep royal blue and electric cyan dragonfire, white-hot flame highlights, black-navy inner energy shadows, gold antler-crown arcs, pearly orb core, sharp spiky final-boss geometry. Card motif only as abstract blank card-shaped light shards and card-back silhouettes, with no readable ranks, no letters, no numbers, no suit symbols, no card faces.

Frame contents:
1. Tiny cold blue pearl glint at center with faint gold antler-crown outline, quiet start.
2. Deep blue motes and small blank card-shaped sparks drift inward toward pearl core.
3. Thin gold crown ring forms around core; three blank blue card shards begin orbiting, no markings.
4. Darker royal-blue vortex opens behind pearl; cyan dragonfire licks upward like small horns.
5. Claw-like blue flame hooks pull blank card shards inward, suggesting Caesar seizing a card.
6. One stolen blank card silhouette locks in front of pearl core, rim-lit cyan and gold, compact.
7. Peak charge: gold antler crown flares, pearl core white-hot, blue dragonfire coils tightly around it.
8. Release begins: diagonal blue-white judgment slash cuts from lower-left to upper-right, card shards trailing behind.
9. Brightest impact: compact crown-shaped burst, electric cyan flame spikes, pearl spark at center.
10. Shock ring expands slightly but remains inside cell; blank card fragments scatter as blue-gold sparks.
11. Energy collapses into smaller royal-blue spiral, gold crown fragments fading near center.
12. Loop-ready settle: faint pearl glint, tiny cyan horns, a few gold dust motes, mostly empty magenta space.

Quality rules: same FX identity across all 12 frames, consistent bounding box and center, clear magenta margin on all sides of every frame, no effect/spark/card shard/slash tip/flame/glow crosses a cell edge, no text-like marks or glyphs, no poker ranks or suits, polished final sprite sheet asset, not a splash illustration, no black background, no smoke cloud covering cells, no wide fullscreen blast.
